title: 中
teacherNotes: Formal Production A handoff. Base 80431be0 with production through L446 音 and 450 unique learned Han. L453-L458 are direct lesson dependencies; Release must preserve ordered L447-L458 and R055/R056 after L450. Allowed set has 457 unique Han. Teach only 中 ㄓㄨㄥ; do not introduce ㄓㄨㄥˋ. 中午/中獎 forbidden. Fixed sentences and Stage 4 data must not drift. S01 exactly three boxes and exactly one empty. S02 is ordinary driftwood, never a real monster. S05 is the replacement meteor sentence, never reuse shadow imagery. No image text or numbers. Production package only; Release owns shared production JSON/planner/ledger integration and main merge.

sentences.text: 三個盒子，其中一個是空的。
sentences.spokenText: 三個盒子其中一個是空的
sentences.imageNotes: 桌上恰好三個打開的盒子，從斜上方看得清內部；其中兩個放著積木，另一個完全空著。主角女孩指向空盒，盒子之間有清楚間隔。不能多畫盒子，空盒裡也不能有紙、包裝物或看似物件的裝飾；不加數字標籤。
sentences.imagePrompt: Modern children’s picture-book illustration locked to the approved L058 style anchors and refined L115/L118/L119/L128 proportion references: warm natural light, fine pencil-and-watercolor linework, detailed but clean environments, stable expressive preschool proportions, soft cheeks, gentle faces, bright warm palette, and phone-readable square composition. L058 is style-only; do not copy its people. Preserve recurring cast identities from the approved L154/L162/L163 family anchors. No visible text, letters, numbers, logos, captions, labels, or watermarks. Slight overhead view of a tabletop with exactly three and only three clearly separated open boxes, all interiors fully visible. Two boxes contain colorful wooden building blocks; the third box is completely empty, with no paper, packing material, shadow-object, decoration, or contents. The recurring protagonist girl points specifically to the empty box. Make the three-box count and one-empty/two-filled contrast unmistakable. No extra boxes anywhere, no number labels. Square 1:1.

sentences.text: 水中那個怪物，其實是木頭。
sentences.spokenText: 水中那個怪物其實是木頭
sentences.imageNotes: 主角女孩和爸爸站在安全岸邊，望向水中一段外形像怪物頭部的漂浮木頭；輪廓遠看容易誤認，但近看能清楚辨識木紋、斷面與枝杈。爸爸指著木頭向女孩說明；沒有真正的怪物，不畫木頭變身、發光眼睛或恐怖水景。
sentences.imagePrompt: Modern children’s picture-book illustration locked to the approved L058 style anchors and refined L115/L118/L119/L128 proportion references: warm natural light, fine pencil-and-watercolor linework, detailed but clean environments, stable expressive preschool proportions, soft cheeks, gentle faces, bright warm palette, and phone-readable square composition. L058 is style-only; do not copy its people. Preserve recurring cast identities from the approved L154/L162/L163 family anchors. No visible text, letters, numbers, logos, captions, labels, or watermarks. The recurring protagonist girl and recurring father stand together on a broad safe pond bank. Father calmly points toward one floating piece of driftwood in the water and explains it to her. Its silhouette could resemble a creature's head from far away, but close visual details make it unmistakably ordinary wood: visible wood grain, a cut end, bark, and natural branch forks. No real monster, face, glowing eyes, transformation, fear, dangerous water, or horror mood. Square 1:1.

sentences.text: 我坐在爸媽中間看表演。
sentences.spokenText: 我坐在爸媽中間看表演
sentences.imageNotes: 觀眾席上，固定主角爸爸、主角女孩、主角媽媽坐在連續三個座位，女孩明確位於爸媽之間；三人面向前方舞台觀看表演。可從側後方構圖，同時看清座位關係及前方活動；不要讓其他人插在三人中間，不用小月替代主角女孩。
sentences.imagePrompt: Modern children’s picture-book illustration locked to the approved L058 style anchors and refined L115/L118/L119/L128 proportion references: warm natural light, fine pencil-and-watercolor linework, detailed but clean environments, stable expressive preschool proportions, soft cheeks, gentle faces, bright warm palette, and phone-readable square composition. L058 is style-only; do not copy its people. Preserve recurring cast identities from the approved L154/L162/L163 family anchors. No visible text, letters, numbers, logos, captions, labels, or watermarks. Side-rear view in an auditorium showing exactly the recurring father, recurring preschool protagonist girl, and recurring mother seated in three adjacent continuous seats in that clear left-to-right family grouping, with the girl unmistakably between her parents. All three look toward a warmly lit performance on the stage ahead. Their seating relationship and the stage action are both visible. No other person sits between them; use the fixed protagonist, not Xiaoyue. Preserve recurring family faces, hair, and proportions. No readable stage text. Square 1:1.

sentences.text: 果實突然掉下來，把我嚇一跳。
sentences.spokenText: 果實突然掉下來把我嚇一跳
sentences.imageNotes: 果園裡，一顆果實剛從低矮果樹落到主角女孩身旁地面，女孩驚訝地稍微退一步；樹上仍有同類果實，讓掉落來源明確。媽媽在近旁，不砸中女孩、不受傷、不畫巨大椰子或高空重物。

No visible text, letters, numbers, logos, captions, labels, or watermarks. In a bright orchard, exactly one ordinary apple-like fruit has just dropped from a low fruit tree and is captured just beside the recurring protagonist girl's feet, with a small natural motion cue. Several matching fruits remain visibly on the same low tree so the source is obvious. The girl takes one small surprised step back; recurring mother stands nearby reassuringly. The fruit does not hit anyone; no injury, giant coconut, high falling object, panic, or danger. Square 1:1.

sentences.imageNotes: 安全的戶外觀星空間，主角女孩與家人抬頭看夜空，一道清楚的流星帶著短光尾劃過；流星不同於背景靜止星點。保留足夠環境光看清人物，不畫隕石撞地、火災、爆炸或危險懸崖。已取代原本的影子句，不能沿用影子配圖。

No visible text, letters, numbers, logos, captions, labels, or watermarks. A safe gently lit outdoor stargazing space at night, such as a flat garden lawn. The recurring protagonist girl and her recurring family look upward together. One clear meteor with a short luminous trail crosses the dark blue sky, visibly different from the many small stationary stars. Keep enough warm environmental light to recognize family faces and identities. No meteor impact, ground fire, explosion, cliff, danger, shadow-focused scene, or old shadow imagery. Square 1:1.
